   - A is the future value (the total amount he wants in his account, $10,000)
   - P is the present value (the amount he invests initially)
   - r is the annual interest rate (in decimal form, 4% is 0.04)
   - n is the number of years (10 in this case)

   P ≈ $10,000 / 1.48044
   P ≈ $6722.163
